A rolling 1y roadmap involves just 10 boxes to fill

With limited space, you can only specify so much.

Not hard to keep continuously up to date

two org structures ....

one with the PO/PM divide

one with a product team

300 person hour all-hands …. Sure

24hrs of more thoughtful design on an initiative … woah there. What’s the ROI ?

product is hard

vanity metrics = easy
thoughtful measurement = hard

individual projects = easy
collaboration = hard

handoffs = easy
starting together = hard

saying yes (or no) = easy
saying "no, but" = hard

success theater = easy
embrace learning = hard

hard, but worth it

here's the thing about the orgs that are seemingly amazing at product, and write posts that spread FOMO

the teams operate under *WAY* less process overhead/dependencies/constraints, and have *much* more flexibility/autonomy.

it looks like skill/chops, but it is mostly freedom
